Hi Markus / Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — excited to get started. We'd like to lock the "welcome" session and a short technical preflight next week. Quick asks from our side: 

- Can you confirm a 60-minute window for the customer welcome (introductions, scope, roles)? We prefer Tue/Wed mornings PT.
- We need an SSO preflight with our IdP engineer (30 min) to validate metadata and test users.

Hi Jill — great to hear. Drafting a plan below and proposing concrete slots.

Proposed calendar:
- Welcome assembly (60 min): Wed, Oct 22, 10:00–11:00 PT (Redwood host: Markus Klein; Goal: intro, success criteria, ownership lanes)
- SSO preflight (30 min): Thu, Oct 23, 09:00–09:30 PT (Redwood host: Karthik Iyer; Goal: metadata exchange + test user)

Draft attendee matrix (high level):
- Customer: Jill Rivera (ops), Aaron Chu (IdP engineer), Priya Shah (Product owner)
- Redwood: Markus Klein (CS lead), Karthik Iyer (Implementation engineer), Grace O'Connor (Onboarding PM)

Draft agenda for Welcome assembly (60 min):
1) 5m — Quick intros + success outcome
2) 15m — High-level integration overview (models/endpoints + data flows)
3) 20m — Implementation milestones & mutual action plan (milestones, owners, timelines)
4) 10m — SSO & security touchpoints (preflight recap)
5) 10m — Q&A + next steps (confirm runbook owners + calendar invites)

Zoom bridge (provisional): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=example — I'll generate the calendar invites once you confirm the slots and attendee emails.

I've attached a quick draft agenda (Onboarding_Draft_Agenda.md) and exported the attendee matrix as CSV for your edits.

If the times above won't work, propose two alternatives and we'll slot them.

Cheers,
Markus Klein\Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (555) 732-0192
